reason: Listeria infection can be passed to unborn baby
foods_to_avoid: Pate and dips; Cold cooked chicken; Deli meats (ham, salami) unless reheated to high temperature; Soft cheeses (brie, camembert, ricotta, feta, blue cheese); Soft serve ice-cream; Unpasteurised dairy products; Uncooked or smoked seafood; Pre-cooked prawns; Pre-prepared salads and cut fruit (if washing uncertain)
safe_alternatives: Soft cheeses in cooked dishes are safe; Freshly cooked seafood and canned seafood is safe; Reheat food until very hot (listeria killed by cooking); Eat freshly prepared food where possible
prevention_measures: Wash hands before preparing food; Ensure chopping boards and utensils are clean; Thoroughly wash vegetables and fruit before eating

prevention_measures: Wear disposable gloves if handling cat litter or gardening; Wash hands after gardening or touching pets
